name: DILVANG Instant Herbal Tea – Polyscias & Chè Vằng
summary: Extract of **Chè Vằng and Polyscias from Quang Tri** – a chè vằng growing area protected by a state-registered **Geographical Indication**. Made with EECV vacuum extraction technology at a GMP-certified factory. Just stir into warm water – no boiling, no steeping, no leaves left behind.
highlights: Quang Tri chè vằng – Geographical Indication
Mix with warm water at 40–50°C, no boiling

sections.title: Ingredients (per 5g sachet)
sections.text:
Chè Vằng (Jasminum subtriplinerve) dry extract 820 mg · Polyscias (Polyscias fruticosa) dry extract 180 mg · Excipient: Maltodextrin.

**Four commitments:** no preservatives · no anti-caking agents · no synthetic flavors · no artificial colors.

sections.title: The Essence of Quang Tri – Origin
sections.text: Quang Tri chè vằng is protected by a state-registered **Geographical Indication**, managed by the Quang Tri Department of Science and Technology. The raw material comes from partner cooperatives and farming households in Cam Lo, Hai Lang and Vinh Linh. Thanks to the local sun, wind and soil, small-leaf chè vằng has a gentle aroma, a light bitterness and a naturally refreshing taste.

sections.title: EECV extraction technology
items: Extracted and concentrated under vacuum at low temperature in a closed system, then freeze-dried.
Retains the natural active compounds (polyphenols, saponins, flavonoids), with color and aroma close to the fresh leaves.
Developed and transferred from a science and technology project managed by the Quang Tri Department of Science and Technology.

sections.title: How to use
sections.text:
**Step 1:** Pour 1 sachet into a cup. **Step 2:** Add 300–400ml of warm water at 40–50°C. **Step 3:** Stir well and enjoy.

**Suggested:** 2–3 sachets a day. No boiling water, no steeping, no leaves to strain.

rows.label: Appearance & taste
rows.value: Pale yellow, with the characteristic aroma and taste of polyscias and chè vằng

story.title: From the chè vằng hills of Quang Tri to your warm cup of tea
story.intro:
The name **DILVANG** joins two plants: **DIL** for *Đinh lăng* (Polyscias) and **VANG** for *Chè vằng*. Both have been part of daily life in Quang Tri for generations.

Every sachet starts on sun-baked, windswept hillsides and in the home gardens of farming families in Vinh Linh, Cam Lo and Hai Lang. The herbs then travel to a GMP-certified factory in Dong Ha. There, people from Quang Tri extract and pack them, so the taste of their homeland can reach more families.
story.home_title: From the herb fields of Quang Tri to your cup
story.home_text:
We want our customers to know where each product comes from and who makes it.

DILVANG tea begins on windswept chè vằng hills and with the polyscias plants in local family gardens. The herbs are extracted at a GMP-certified factory in Dong Ha, whose opening was covered by VTV, Vietnam's national broadcaster.

steps.alt: Chè vằng hills in Quang Tri under the sun
steps.title: Harsh sun, resilient plants
steps.text: Quang Tri has fierce sun and the hot Lao wind in summer. Yet chè vằng stays green on these gravelly hillsides. Locals see it as a symbol of resilience. **Quang Tri chè vằng** is protected by a state-registered Geographical Indication.

steps.title: Polyscias from family gardens
steps.text: Vietnamese people treasure polyscias; many call it “Vietnam's ginseng”. In Vinh Linh it grows in home gardens on rich red soil. Old plants grow golden roots like the ones in this photo.

steps.alt: Farmers delivering polyscias to the factory
steps.title: From the growers' hands
steps.text: The herbs come from cooperatives and farming households in Cam Lo, Hai Lang and Vinh Linh. Every delivery to the factory brings income to local families, so these native herbs keep growing on their home soil.

steps.alt: Staff checking herb drying racks at the factory
steps.title: Cleaned and dried at low temperature
steps.text: At the factory, fresh herbs are sorted and cleaned, then dried at low temperature with heat-pump and vacuum dryers. For this drying technology, Gold Herbal was recognised as a **Science and Technology Enterprise** by the Quang Tri Department of Science and Technology (2025). Dried chè vằng and polyscias are listed in the certificate.

steps.alt: Staff recording and checking each batch
steps.title: EECV vacuum extraction
steps.text: The herbs are extracted and concentrated in a closed vacuum system at low temperature. Each 5g sachet contains extract equivalent to about **3.5g of dried chè vằng and 1.5g of dried polyscias**. The technology was transferred from a science project managed by the Quang Tri Department of Science and Technology.

steps.alt: Pouring DILVANG tea into a cup
steps.title: Your warm cup of tea
steps.text: No boiling, no simmering, no leaves left behind. One sachet and 300–400ml of warm water make a fragrant, gentle cup of tea, bringing the taste of the Quang Tri hills to your family.
